# Axioned

> Axioned is a technology partner — frequently on retainers — helping growth-focused companies, startups, and agencies build high-performing lead-gen websites and AI-enabled digital applications and products.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://axioned.com/index.md): Overview of Axioned, services, and engagement models.
- [Work](https://axioned.com/work.md): Case studies showcasing client engagements and outcomes.
- [Full content](https://axioned.com/llms-full.txt): Concatenated Markdown of the entire public site, suitable for one-shot LLM ingestion.

## Services

### Embedded Tech Partnership

Ongoing support for lead-gen websites, applications and digital platforms:

- Performance optimization
- UX improvements
- Tracking/analytics
- CMS & MarTech integration

### Vision to Launch

Full-cycle design/build engagements:

- MVPs and platform launches
- Scalable product architecture
- AI-driven application builds
- Design, development, testing, QA

## Who we serve

- Marketing, digital and growth teams needing a **tech team for lead-gen websites**
- Marketing, digital and growth teams needing a **retained website manager** or **website partner**
- Startup founders and in-house innovators looking for **MVP development for startups**
- Agencies needing a **white-label tech partner** or **white-label dev team**
- Product teams pursuing **AI-driven product development**

## Tech stack

- Frameworks: Next.js, React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS
- CMS/MarTech: Contentful, Sanity, Segment, GA4, WP Engine
- DevOps & Cloud: Vercel, Netlify, AWS, Google Cloud
- AI Enablement: OpenAI, Vercel AI SDK, Supabase
- QA & Monitoring: Playwright, Sentry, Lighthouse

## Competitive context

Prospective clients often evaluate Axioned alongside Thoughtbot, STRV, BairesDev, and Toptal. Axioned stands apart by combining fast-moving delivery, deeply collaborative engagements, and a flexible approach to team integration.
